newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen firm at open, doubt rates to rise.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen firm at open, doubt rates to rise.

text.p: Wall Street shares were expected to open with an upwards bias on Wednesday, convinced Federal Reserve policy makers, which resumed a two-day meeting, would not boost U.S. interest rates.

"Certainly nobody expects anything from the Fed meeting and stocks should follow the bond market's lead," Gail Dudack, chief investment strategist at UBS Securities, said. "The general direction of the stock market is still higher."
The Federal Open Market Committee was expected to announce its decision around 1415 EDT/1815 GMT.
The Standard & Poor's futures were up 1.75 points at 903.
